name: Daisy Cubes Are Strictly Dismantlable Ample
statement: Every daisy cube admits a corner peeling, while some dismantlable ample partial cubes are not daisy cubes.
proof: Daisy cubes lie in the peripheral-recursive class, which is contained in the dismantlable ample class. The path $P_4$ is ample of VC dimension one and hence dismantlable ample, but a daisy cube whose graph is a tree must be a star.
